name: Galaxy Digital
industry_role: diversified crypto merchant bank operating one large AI data center campus
notes:
Not a pure-play crypto miner (a diversified crypto merchant bank, founded by Mike Novogratz) -- but bought and converted the "Helios" bitcoin mining site (from Argo Blockchain, ~$65M, late 2022) into an AI data center campus leased to CoreWeave (15-yr lease, ~526MW critical IT load, ~$1B annual revenue projected). Campus scaled to 1.63GW approved, potential 3.6GW -- among the furthest-along crypto-to-AI conversions in delivered IT load.

M&A: acquired Argo Blockchain -- $65M + $35M loan (closed 29 Dec 2022): the 180MW Helios site in Dickens County, TX -- now Galaxy's AI/HPC anchor. [asset purchase (completed); confidence high; https://www.argoblockchain.com/news-room/2022-december-helios-sale-to-galaxy]
